record.question: A teenage girl nearly drowned during her swimming session at school. Which of the following signs indicates that she has respiratory arrest?
record.explanation: Answer B: Absent lung sound. Respiratory arrest is absence of breathing/ventilation; absent lung sounds are the most relevant listed sign. No pulse would indicate cardiac arrest. Source/context note: Assess breathing and pulse immediately; do not delay emergency response. Reference: https://www.heart.org/en/cpr. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
